svg.title: A TLS 1.3 handshake
svg.desc: The client sends ClientHello with its key shares. The server answers in one flight: ServerHello, then encrypted EncryptedExtensions, Certificate, CertificateVerify and Finished. Certificate and CertificateVerify are the authentication bytes. The client answers with Finished and data can flow.

text.tspan: hybrid ML-KEM share: 1,216 B (X25519 alone: 32 B)
